title: hesperus graph
description: Schema version 5. A file with `unindexed` set was in a language the editor could not resolve: it is a file node with no definitions or edges inside it; `doc` says why. A `state` is a constant value a field or variable is assigned; `transition` edges run between a location's states. A `guard` edge from a callable to a state means the code in its `site` runs only when the location holds that state (label `==`) or does not (`!=`). An `event` is one value of a parameter a callable dispatches on (`m.type == "toggle"`), a child of that callable; `guard` edges to it mark the code that handles it. An `event` is also a function literal handed to code outside the repo (a listener); its `guard` edge, labeled `callback`, covers the literal. A `call` edge labeled `callback` from an external node means code outside the repo calls the target. Mirrored by vscode/src/core/ir.ts; change both together.
